## My request for Codex:
lets fix my publications page for my quarto. this is waht chatgpt gave me:

Short answer: you can build this with plain Quarto + a tiny Python chunk + Bootstrap buttons. You only need a *small* SCSS snippet to push the big year label into the margin (the rest works out-of-the-box).

Here’s a minimal, copy-pasteable setup.

### 1) Project tree

```
/publications-site
├─ _quarto.yml
├─ styles.scss
├─ publications.qmd
└─ _data/pubs.yml
```

### 2) `_quarto.yml`

```yaml
project:
  type: website
website:
  title: "Your Name"
  navbar:
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - href: publications.qmd
        text: Publications
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    css: styles.scss     # <- our tiny CSS
    link-external-newwindow: true
```

### 3) `_data/pubs.yml` (sample data)

```yaml
- title: Multi-Objective-Guided Generative Design of mRNA with Therapeutic Properties
  authors: [Sawan Patel, Sophia Tang, Yinuo Zhang, Pranam Chatterjee, Sherwood Yao]
  venue: ICML 2025 GenBio Workshop (preprint), Jul 2025
  year: 2025
  pdf: https://example.com/paper.pdf
  poster: https://example.com/poster.pdf
  code: https://github.com/you/repo
  video: https://youtu.be/xxxxx
  abstract: >
    We introduce a multi-objective framework that ...
  thumb: /assets/thumbs/mobj-mrna.png

- title: Branched Schrödinger Bridge Matching
  authors: [Sophia Tang, Yinuo Zhang, Alexander Tong, Pranam Chatterjee]
  venue: arXiv, Jun 2025
  year: 2025
  paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/xxxx.xxxxx
  code: https://github.com/you/repo2
  poster:
  video:
  abstract: >
    We propose a branched SB method that ...
  thumb: /assets/thumbs/branched-sb.png
```

> Keys supported below: `pdf`, `paper`, `code`, `poster`, `video`, `abstract`, `thumb`. Add/remove as you like.

### 4) `publications.qmd`

````markdown
---
title: "Publications"
page-layout: article
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{python}
import yaml, itertools, html, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

pubs = yaml.safe_load(Path("_data/pubs.yml").read_text())
pubs = sorted(pubs, key=lambda p: (-p["year"], p["title"]))

def btn(url, label):
    return f'<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-dark me-2" href="{url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{label}</a>'

def buttons(p):
    labels = [("pdf","PDF"), ("paper","PAPER"), ("code","CODE"), ("poster","POSTER"), ("video","VIDEO")]
    return " ".join(btn(p[k], lab) for k,lab in labels if p.get(k))

html_out = []
for year, items in itertools.groupby(pubs, key=lambda p: p["year"]):
    html_out.append(f'<section class="year-chunk"><div class="year-label">{year}</div>')
    for p in items:
        tid = "abs-" + hashlib.md5(p["title"].encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        thumb = p.get("thumb") or "https://via.placeholder.com/160x100.png?text=Figure"
        abs_text = html.escape(p.get("abstract","(no abstract provided)"))
        html_out.append(f"""
<div class="pub d-flex gap-3 mb-5">
  <img src="{thumb}" class="thumb rounded" alt="">
  <div>
    <div class="fw-semibold">{html.escape(p["title"])}</div>
    <div class="text-muted small">{html.escape(", ".join(p["authors"]))} · {html.escape(p.get("venue",""))}</div>
    <div class="mt-2">{buttons(p)}
      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-light" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#{tid}" aria-expanded="false">ABSTRACT</button>
    </div>
    <div id="{tid}" class="collapse mt-2">
      <div class="card card-body small">{abs_text}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
""")
    html_out.append("</section>")
print("".join(html_out))
````

````

### 5) `styles.scss` (the *only* custom styling)
```scss
/* Thumbnail + spacing */
.thumb { width: 160px; height: 100px; object-fit: cover; }

/* Year label in margin (desktop), inline on mobile */
.year-chunk { position: relative; }
.year-label {
  position: sticky; top: 4rem;
  float: right;
  font-weight: 700; opacity: .12;
  font-size: 5.5rem; line-height: 1;
  margin-right: .25rem; user-select: none;
}
@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .year-label {
    position: static; float: none;
    font-size: 2rem; opacity: .5;
    margin: 1rem 0 .5rem;
  }
}
````

### How it works / notes

* **Year on the side**: done with a single sticky, low-opacity `.year-label`. That’s why we add a tiny SCSS file—everything else is Bootstrap.
* **Buttons**: standard Bootstrap button classes (`.btn .btn-outline-dark`). No extra CSS needed.
* **Abstract**: Bootstrap **collapse** component toggled by an “ABSTRACT” button.
* **Data source**: one YAML file (`_data/pubs.yml`) you can edit without touching the page.
* **Python Markdown**: the page is rendered by a Python chunk that loads YAML, groups by year, and emits HTML.

If you’d rather avoid any SCSS at all, drop `styles.scss` and put the year as a normal heading between groups; you’ll lose the margin effect but everything else will still work.

page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import itertools
import hashlib
import html
import json

data_path = Path("_data/pubs.yml")
data_text = data_path.read_text()

try:
  import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
except ModuleNotFoundError:
  yaml = None

if yaml is not None:
  pubs = yaml.safe_load(data_text)
else:
  try:
    pubs = json.loads(data_text)
  except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
    raise RuntimeError("Install PyYAML (pip install pyyaml) or keep _data/pubs.yml in JSON syntax.") from exc

def ensure_list(value):
  if isinstance(value, list):
    return value
  if isinstance(value, str):
    return [part.strip() for part in value.split(",") if part.strip()]
  return []

def btn(url, label):
  safe_url = html.escape(url, quote=True)
  safe_label = html.escape(label)
  return f'<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-dark me-2" href="{safe_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{safe_label}</a>'

def buttons(pub):
  actions = [("pdf", "PDF"), ("paper", "PAPER"), ("code", "CODE"), ("poster", "POSTER"), ("video", "VIDEO")]
  return " ".join(btn(pub[key], label) for key, label in actions if pub.get(key))

pubs_sorted = sorted(
  pubs,
  key=lambda item: (-int(item.get("year", 0)), item.get("title", "")),
)

html_parts = []
for year, group in itertools.groupby(pubs_sorted, key=lambda p: int(p.get("year", 0))):
  html_parts.append(f'<section class="year-chunk"><div class="year-label">{year}</div>')
  for pub in group:
    title = html.escape(pub.get("title", "Untitled"))
    authors_list = ensure_list(pub.get("authors", []))
    authors_block = ""
    if authors_list:
      authors_block = f'<div class="text-muted small mt-1">{html.escape(", ".join(authors_list))}</div>'
    venue = pub.get("venue", "")
    venue_block = f'<div class="text-muted small">{html.escape(venue)}</div>' if venue else ""
    thumb = html.escape(pub.get("thumb") or "/assets/img/publications/featured.png", quote=True)
    abstract_text = html.escape(pub.get("abstract", "(abstract unavailable)"))
    target_id = "abs-" + hashlib.md5(pub.get("title", str(year)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
    links = buttons(pub)
    pub_number = pub.get("pub_number")
    badge_html = f'<span class="pub-badge">#{html.escape(str(pub_number))}</span>' if pub_number else ""
    html_parts.append(
      f"""
<div class="pub d-flex flex-column flex-md-row gap-3 mb-5">
  <img src="{thumb}" class="thumb rounded" alt="{title}">
  <div class="flex-grow-1">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-start flex-wrap gap-2">
      {badge_html}
      <div class="fw-semibold h5 mb-0">{title}</div>
    </div>
    {authors_block}
    {venue_block}
    <div class="mt-3 d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2">
      {links}
      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-light" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#{target_id}" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="{target_id}">ABSTRACT</button>
    </div>
    <div id="{target_id}" class="collapse mt-2">
      <div class="card card-body small">{abstract_text}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
"""
    )
  html_parts.append("</section>")

print("".join(html_parts))
```
EOF
]
```

from pathlib import Path
import itertools
import hashlib
import html
import json

data_path = Path("_data/pubs.yml")
data_text = data_path.read_text()

try:
    import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    yaml = None

if yaml is not None:
    pubs = yaml.safe_load(data_text)
else:
    try:
        pubs = json.loads(data_text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("Install PyYAML (pip install pyyaml) or keep _data/pubs.yml in JSON syntax.") from exc

def ensure_list(value):
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return [part.strip() for part in value.split(",") if part.strip()]
    return []

def btn(url, label):
    safe_url = html.escape(url, quote=True)
    safe_label = html.escape(label)
    return f'<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-dark me-2" href="{safe_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{safe_label}</a>'

def buttons(pub):
    actions = [("pdf", "PDF"), ("paper", "PAPER"), ("code", "CODE"), ("poster", "POSTER"), ("video", "VIDEO")]
    return " ".join(btn(pub[key], label) for key, label in actions if pub.get(key))

pubs_sorted = sorted(
    pubs,
    key=lambda item: (-int(item.get("year", 0)), item.get("title", "")),
)

html_parts = []
for year, group in itertools.groupby(pubs_sorted, key=lambda p: int(p.get("year", 0))):
    html_parts.append(f'<section class="year-chunk"><div class="year-label">{year}</div>')
    for pub in group:
        title = html.escape(pub.get("title", "Untitled"))
        authors_list = ensure_list(pub.get("authors", []))
        authors_block = ""
        if authors_list:
            authors_block = f'<div class="text-muted small mt-1">{html.escape(", ".join(authors_list))}</div>'
        venue = pub.get("venue", "")
        venue_block = f'<div class="text-muted small">{html.escape(venue)}</div>' if venue else ""
        thumb = html.escape(pub.get("thumb") or "/assets/img/publications/featured.png", quote=True)
        abstract_text = html.escape(pub.get("abstract", "(abstract unavailable)"))
        target_id = "abs-" + hashlib.md5(pub.get("title", str(year)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        links = buttons(pub)
        pub_number = pub.get("pub_number")
        badge_html = f'<span class="pub-badge">#{html.escape(str(pub_number))}</span>' if pub_number else ""
        html_parts.append(
            f"""
<div class="pub d-flex flex-column flex-md-row gap-3 mb-5">
  <img src="{thumb}" class="thumb rounded" alt="{title}">
  <div class="flex-grow-1">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-start flex-wrap gap-2">
      {badge_html}
      <div class="fw-semibold h5 mb-0">{title}</div>
    </div>
    {authors_block}
    {venue_block}
    <div class="mt-3 d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2">
      {links}
      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-light" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#{target_id}" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="{target_id}">ABSTRACT</button>
    </div>
    <div id="{target_id}" class="collapse mt-2">
      <div class="card card-body small">{abstract_text}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
"""
        )
    html_parts.append("</section>")

print("".join(html_parts))

#| results: asis
from pathlib import Path
import itertools
import hashlib
import html
import json
from IPython.display import HTML, display

data_path = Path("_data/pubs.yml")
data_text = data_path.read_text()

try:
    import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    yaml = None

if yaml is not None:
    pubs = yaml.safe_load(data_text)
else:
    try:
        pubs = json.loads(data_text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("Install PyYAML (pip install pyyaml) or keep _data/pubs.yml in JSON syntax.") from exc

def ensure_list(value):
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return [part.strip() for part in value.split(",") if part.strip()]
    return []

def btn(url, label):
    safe_url = html.escape(url, quote=True)
    safe_label = html.escape(label)
    return f'<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-dark me-2" href="{safe_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{safe_label}</a>'

def buttons(pub):
    actions = [("pdf", "PDF"), ("paper", "PAPER"), ("code", "CODE"), ("poster", "POSTER"), ("video", "VIDEO")]
    return " ".join(btn(pub[key], label) for key, label in actions if pub.get(key))

pubs_sorted = sorted(
    pubs,
    key=lambda item: (-int(item.get("year", 0)), item.get("title", "")),
)

html_parts = []
for year, group in itertools.groupby(pubs_sorted, key=lambda p: int(p.get("year", 0))):
    html_parts.append(f'<section class="year-chunk"><div class="year-label">{year}</div>')
    for pub in group:
        title = html.escape(pub.get("title", "Untitled"))
        authors_list = ensure_list(pub.get("authors", []))
        authors_block = ""
        if authors_list:
            authors_block = f'<div class="text-muted small mt-1">{html.escape(", ".join(authors_list))}</div>'
        venue = pub.get("venue", "")
        venue_block = f'<div class="text-muted small">{html.escape(venue)}</div>' if venue else ""
        thumb = html.escape(pub.get("thumb") or "/assets/img/publications/featured.png", quote=True)
        abstract_text = html.escape(pub.get("abstract", "(abstract unavailable)"))
        target_id = "abs-" + hashlib.md5(pub.get("title", str(year)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        links = buttons(pub)
        pub_number = pub.get("pub_number")
        badge_html = f'<span class="pub-badge">#{html.escape(str(pub_number))}</span>' if pub_number else ""
        html_parts.append(
            f"""
<div class="pub d-flex flex-column flex-md-row gap-3 mb-5">
  <img src="{thumb}" class="thumb rounded" alt="{title}">
  <div class="flex-grow-1">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-start flex-wrap gap-2">
      {badge_html}
      <div class="fw-semibold h5 mb-0">{title}</div>
    </div>
    {authors_block}
    {venue_block}
    <div class="mt-3 d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2">
      {links}
      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-light" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#{target_id}" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="{target_id}">ABSTRACT</button>
    </div>
    <div id="{target_id}" class="collapse mt-2">
      <div class="card card-body small">{abstract_text}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
"""
        )
    html_parts.append("</section>")

display(HTML("".join(html_parts)))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const input = document.getElementById('pub-search-input');
  if (!input) {
    return;
  }
  const clearBtn = document.getElementById('pub-search-clear');
  const emptyState = document.getElementById('pub-search-empty');
  const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.year-chunk'));
  const pubs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pub'));

  function update() {
    const query = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    let visibleCount = 0;

    pubs.forEach((card) => {
      const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
      const match = !query || text.includes(query);
      card.classList.toggle('d-none', !match);
      if (match) {
        visibleCount += 1;
      }
    });

    sections.forEach((section) => {
      const hasVisible = section.querySelector('.pub:not(.d-none)');
      section.classList.toggle('d-none', query && !hasVisible);
    });

    if (clearBtn) {
      clearBtn.classList.toggle('d-none', query.length === 0);
    }

    if (emptyState) {
      emptyState.classList.toggle('d-none', visibleCount > 0);
    }
  }

  input.addEventListener('input', update, { passive: true });

  if (clearBtn) {
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      input.value = '';
      input.focus();
      update();
    });
  }

  update();
})();
</script>

_**Agent (gpt-5-codex 2025-09-29 23:42:00Z)**_

Right now only the keys listed inside the `actions` array in `publications.qmd` get buttons:

```python
actions = [("pdf", "PDF"), ("paper", "PAPER"), ("code", "CODE"),
           ("poster", "POSTER"), ("video", "VIDEO")]
```

If you add a `poster` or `video` URL to `_data/pubs.yml`, the matching button appears automatically (and it disappears when the value is missing). For any new resource type—say `slides` or `dataset`—you just need to add another tuple to that list, e.g.

```python
actions = [
    ("pdf", "PDF"),
    ("paper", "PAPER"),
    ("code", "CODE"),
    ("poster", "POSTER"),
    ("video", "VIDEO"),
    ("slides", "SLIDES"),
]
```

After you add the key and re-render, the new button will show up for any publication that includes the `slides` entry.

+
+## Technical Talks & Presentations
+
+```{python}
+#| results: asis
+from pathlib import Path
+import html
+import json
+import re
+
+talks_path = Path("_data/talks.yml")
+talks_data = talks_path.read_text()
+
+try:
+    import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
+except ModuleNotFoundError:
+    yaml = None
+
+if yaml is not None:
+    talks = yaml.safe_load(talks_data)
+else:
+    talks = json.loads(talks_data)
+
+def talk_year(entry):
+    date_text = str(entry.get("date", ""))
+    match = re.search(r"(20\d{2}|19\d{2})", date_text)
+    if match:
+        return int(match.group(0))
+    return 0
+
+def talk_buttons(entry):
+    resources = [("slides", "SLIDES"), ("poster", "POSTER"), ("video", "VIDEO")]
+    buttons = []
+    for key, label in resources:
+        url = entry.get(key)
+        if url:
+            safe_url = html.escape(url, quote=True)
+            safe_label = html.escape(label)
+            buttons.append(
+                f'<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-dark" href="{safe_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{safe_label}</a>'
+            )
+    return " ".join(buttons)
+
+talks_sorted = sorted(
+    talks,
+    key=lambda t: (-talk_year(t), t.get("event", ""), t.get("title", "")),
+)
+
+rows = ["<div class='talk-list'>"]
+for talk in talks_sorted:
+    title = html.escape(talk.get("title", "Untitled"))
+    authors = talk.get("authors", [])
+    authors_html = ""
+    if authors:
+        authors_html = f"<div class='talk-meta'>{html.escape(', '.join(authors))}</div>"
+    info_bits = " · ".join(filter(None, [talk.get("event", ""), talk.get("date", ""), talk.get("location", "")]))
+    info_html = f"<div class='talk-meta text-muted'>{html.escape(info_bits)}</div>" if info_bits else ""
+    type_label = talk.get("type")
+    badge_html = f"<div class='talk-badge'>{html.escape(type_label)}</div>" if type_label else ""
+    resources_html = talk_buttons(talk)
+    actions_html = f"<div class='talk-actions'>{resources_html}</div>" if resources_html else ""
+    rows.append(
+        f"""
+<div class='talk-card'>
+  {badge_html}
+  <div class='talk-title fw-semibold'>{title}</div>
+  {authors_html}
+  {info_html}
+  {actions_html}
+</div>
+"""
+    )
+rows.append("</div>")
+print("".join(rows))
+```
*** End Patch
PATCH
]
```

```{python}
#| results: asis
from pathlib import Path
import html
import json

projects_path = Path("_data/projects.yml")
projects_text = projects_path.read_text()

try:
    import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    yaml = None

if yaml is not None:
    projects = yaml.safe_load(projects_text)
else:
    projects = json.loads(projects_text)

fallback_image = "/assets/img/publications/featured.webp"

def project_buttons(entry):
    links = entry.get("links") or []
    buttons = []
    for link in links:
        url = link.get("url")
        label = link.get("label") or "Link"
        if not url:
            continue
        safe_url = html.escape(url, quote=True)
        safe_label = html.escape(label)
        buttons.append(
            f'<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-dark me-2" href="{safe_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{safe_label}</a>'
        )
    return " ".join(buttons)

rows = ["<div class='project-list'>"]
for project in projects:
    title = html.escape(project.get("title", "Untitled Project"))
    summary = html.escape(project.get("summary", ""))
    timeline = project.get("timeline")
    org = project.get("org")
    role = project.get("role")
    meta_bits = [bit for bit in [timeline, org, role] if bit]
    meta_html = (
        f"<div class='text-muted small'>{html.escape(' · '.join(meta_bits))}</div>"
        if meta_bits
        else ""
    )
    tags = project.get("tags") or []
    tags_html = ""
    if tags:
        tag_spans = "".join(
            f"<span class='project-tag'>{html.escape(tag)}</span>" for tag in tags
        )
        tags_html = f"<div class='project-tags'>{tag_spans}</div>"
    image_src = html.escape(project.get("image") or fallback_image, quote=True)
    buttons_html = project_buttons(project)
    actions_html = f"<div class='pub-actions mt-2'>{buttons_html}</div>" if buttons_html else ""
    rows.append(
        f"""
<div class='pub project-card mb-5'>
  <div class='pub-image'><img src='{image_src}' class='thumb rounded' alt='{title}'></div>
  <div class='pub-body'>
    <div class='pub-title fw-semibold h5 mb-0'>{title}</div>
    {meta_html}
    {tags_html}
    <p class='project-summary mt-2 mb-0'>{summary}</p>
    {actions_html}
  </div>
</div>
"""
    )
rows.append("</div>")
print("".join(rows))
```
EOF
]

        tag_spans = "".join(

        )
        tags_html = f"<div class='project-tags'>{tag_spans}</div>"

#| echo: false
#| results: asis
from pathlib import Path
import html
import json
from datetime import datetime
from IPython.display import HTML, display

news_path = Path("_data/news.yml")
news_text = news_path.read_text()

try:
    import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    yaml = None

if yaml is not None:
    entries = yaml.safe_load(news_text)
else:
    entries = json.loads(news_text)

items = []
for entry in entries or []:
    date_str = entry.get("date", "")
    try:
        dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
    except ValueError:
        dt = datetime.min
    items.append((dt, entry))

items.sort(reverse=True)

rows = ["<section class='news-timeline'>"]
for dt, entry in items:
    title = html.escape(entry.get("title", "Untitled highlight"))
    summary = html.escape(entry.get("summary", ""))
    location = entry.get("location")
    link = entry.get("link")
    date_label = dt.strftime("%b %d, %Y") if dt != datetime.min else ""
    location_html = f"<span class='news-location'>{html.escape(location)}</span>" if location else ""
    meta = " · ".join(bit for bit in [date_label, location_html] if bit)
    meta_html = f"<div class='news-meta'>{meta}</div>" if meta else ""
    if link:
        safe_link = html.escape(link, quote=True)
        title_html = f"<a href='{safe_link}' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>{title}</a>"
    else:
        title_html = title
    rows.append(
        f"""
<div class='news-item'>
  <div class='news-marker'></div>
  <div class='news-content'>
    <h3 class='news-title'>{title_html}</h3>
    {meta_html}
    <p class='news-summary'>{summary}</p>
  </div>
</div>
"""
    )
rows.append("</section>")

if not items:
    rows = ["<p>No news to share yet. Check back soon!</p>"]

display(HTML("".join(rows)))
```
EOF
]

### Joseph Frimpong
Postdoctoral researcher at Argonne National Laboratory exploring many-body electronic-structure theory, machine learning, and scalable workflows for heterogeneous materials.
:::

::: {.home-intro}
I build computational tools that connect electronic-structure theory with data-driven models to accelerate materials discovery. ## Latest Posts

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
from pathlib import Path
import html
import json
from datetime import datetime

posts_root = Path("blog/posts")
post_entries = []

try:
    import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    yaml = None

def parse_front_matter(text: str):
    if not text.startswith("---\n"):
        return {}
    end = text.find("\n---", 4)
    if end == -1:
        return {}
    fm = text[4:end]
    if yaml is not None:
        return yaml.safe_load(fm)
    data = {}
    for line in fm.splitlines():
        if ":" in line:
            key, value = line.split(":", 1)
            data[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"')
    return data

for post_dir in sorted(posts_root.glob("*/index.qmd")):
    text = post_dir.read_text()
    meta = parse_front_matter(text)
    if not meta or meta.get("draft"):
        continue
    date_str = meta.get("date", "")
    try:
        dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
    except ValueError:
        dt = datetime.min
    post_entries.append((dt, meta.get("title", "Untitled"), post_dir))

post_entries.sort(reverse=True)
post_entries = post_entries[:3]

if not post_entries:
    html_output = "<p>No posts yet. Check back soon!</p>"
else:
    items = []
    for dt, title, path in post_entries:
        title_html = html.escape(title)
        date_label = dt.strftime("%b %d, %Y") if dt != datetime.min else ""
        rel_path = Path("blog") / path.parent.name / ""
        items.append(
            f"<li><span class='post-date'>{date_label}</span> <a href='{rel_path.as_posix()}'>{title_html}</a></li>"
        )
    html_output = "<ul class='latest-posts'>" + "".join(items) + "</ul>"

print(html_output)
```

## News & Highlights

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
from pathlib import Path
import html
import json
from datetime import datetime

news_path = Path("_data/news.yml")
news_text = news_path.read_text()

try:
    import yaml  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    yaml = None

if yaml is not None:
    news_entries = yaml.safe_load(news_text)
else:
    news_entries = json.loads(news_text)

items = []
for entry in news_entries or []:
    date_str = entry.get("date", "")
    try:
        dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
    except ValueError:
        dt = datetime.min
    items.append((dt, entry))

items.sort(reverse=True)
items = items[:2]

if not items:
    html_output = "<p><a href='news.qmd'>Visit the news page for updates.</a></p>"
else:
    cards = []
    for dt, entry in items:
        title = html.escape(entry.get("title", "New update"))
        summary = html.escape(entry.get("summary", ""))
        link = entry.get("link")
        date_label = dt.strftime("%b %d, %Y") if dt != datetime.min else ""
        if link:
            safe_link = html.escape(link, quote=True)
            title_html = f"<a href='{safe_link}' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>{title}</a>"
        else:
            title_html = title
        cards.append(
            f"<div class='news-card'><div class='news-card-date'>{date_label}</div><div class='news-card-title'>{title_html}</div><p class='news-card-summary'>{summary}</p></div>"
        )
    cards.append("<p class='news-link'><a href='news.qmd'>See all news →</a></p>")
    html_output = "<div class='news-card-grid'>" + "".join(cards) + "</div>"

print(html_output)
```

[bash -lc cat <<'EOF' > _data/generate_home_sections.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate homepage include snippets for latest posts and news."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BLOG_DIR = ROOT / "blog" / "posts"
NEWS_FILE = ROOT / "_data" / "news.yml"
LATEST_POSTS_INCLUDE = ROOT / "_includes" / "home-latest-posts.md"
NEWS_INCLUDE = ROOT / "_includes" / "home-news.md"


def parse_front_matter(text: str) -> dict:
    if not text.startswith("---\n"):
        return {}
    end = text.find("\n---", 4)
    if end == -1:
        return {}
    fm = text[4:end]
    # treat front matter as YAML but fall back to simple dict parsing
    try:
        import yaml  # type: ignore
    except Exception:
        data = {}
        for line in fm.splitlines():
            if ":" in line:
                key, value = line.split(":", 1)
                data[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"')
        return data
    else:
        return yaml.safe_load(fm) or {}


def latest_posts(max_items: int = 3) -> list[dict]:
    entries: list[tuple[datetime, dict, Path]] = []
    for post_dir in BLOG_DIR.glob("*/index.qmd"):
        meta = parse_front_matter(post_dir.read_text())
        if not meta or meta.get("draft"):
            continue
        date_str = meta.get("date", "")
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            dt = datetime.min
        entries.append((dt, meta, post_dir))
    entries.sort(reverse=True)
    return [
        {
            "title": meta.get("title", "Untitled"),
            "date": dt.strftime("%b %d, %Y") if dt != datetime.min else "",
            "path": f"blog/posts/{post_dir.parent.name}/",
        }
        for dt, meta, post_dir in entries[:max_items]
    ]


def write_latest_posts():
    items = latest_posts()
    if not items:
        content = "No posts yet. Check back soon!\n"
    else:
        lines = [
            f"- **{item['date']}** – [{item['title']}]({item['path']})"
            for item in items
        ]
        content = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    LATEST_POSTS_INCLUDE.write_text(content)


def write_news():
    raw = NEWS_FILE.read_text()
    try:
        entries = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        try:
            import yaml  # type: ignore
        except Exception:
            entries = []
        else:
            entries = yaml.safe_load(raw) or []
    news_items: list[tuple[datetime, dict]] = []
    for entry in entries:
        date_str = entry.get("date", "")
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            dt = datetime.min
        news_items.append((dt, entry))
    news_items.sort(reverse=True)
    if not news_items:
        NEWS_INCLUDE.write_text("No news yet.\n")
        return
    lines = []
    for dt, entry in news_items:
        date_label = dt.strftime("%b %d, %Y") if dt != datetime.min else ""
        title = entry.get("title", "Update")
        summary = entry.get("summary")
        line = f"- **{date_label}** – {title}"
        if summary:
            line += f" — {summary}"
        lines.append(line)
    NEWS_INCLUDE.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    write_latest_posts()
    write_news()
EOF
]
```
